Summary: mid-market SaaS (product: CustomerCore) building chat-first support agents. Primary goal is Hosted API for fast launch, then Dedicated if traffic & cost justify reserved capacity. Engineering-led evaluation (CTO + VP Eng).

Key technical requirements:
- Streaming required (progressive UI chunks), <1.5s first-token SLO for majority of sessions (EU especially important).
- Tool calling: must integrate with their ticketing API (REST) and an internal KB microservice, support structured function outputs.
- Fallbacks: prefer automatic model fallback to smaller/quantized variant on heavy load.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency percentiles, error traces for streaming failures.
